verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer page says the DBX Platform lets apps add Dropbox features including search, so a developer-facing search capability exists. Nothing in the pack documents its endpoints or shows that it matches full-text file content rather than just filenames or prefixes. Dash's cross-app knowledge search is an end-user product, not evidence of the API. missing for 10: documented search endpoint reference, evidence of full-text content search beyond filenames, query semantics beyond prefix matching, independent or hands-on corroboration.
